content.comment_body: Question 1: Are these two [product_name] expansion modules compatible with the [product_name] basis module with part number [article_no]? Expansion module 1: [article_no]. Expansion module 2: [article_no]. Question 2: Which version of [product_name] software can be used to program this [product_name] basis module? Thank you, [user_name]

Your [product_name] with article number [article_no] is the current model. For this device, you need [product_name] software version [version_no]. The upgrade can be downloaded for free from [url]. However, the download is export restricted and requires extended registration. Why is it necessary to log in and register for export-restricted software, and what data is required for this? All expansion modules with article numbers ending in [article_no] are compatible with [version_no] devices.

analysis.insight_summary: Users want to understand hardware compatibility between different [product_name] basis and expansion modules, along with which software version is suitable for programming. The confusion arises due to the complexity of article numbers and specific version needs. Access to the required software is also a concern due to registration barriers and export restrictions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect expansion modules to be compatible based primarily on article numbers and want straightforward advice about the software version required for programming. They also expect to access the programming software easily.
